HexKagune 1.0.9 for Forge 1.20.1 (needs PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon on clients; the server needs only Forge). Install on both the client and the server; everyone on a server needs this jar.

**Fixes to the half kakujas' look**
- **Peace's cross blades mirror each other.** The two wings' blades used to all lean the same way. Now each wing is the other's mirror image: the long points lean in toward you on both sides, and the blades turn as mirror images too.
- **War's head is bowed.** War keeps his god's stance (leaning back, arms open), but his head now stays bowed, about twenty degrees down. He glares up from under his brow the way Kid Buu does. The tilts and twitches play on top of the bow.

Not yet tried in game; checked in offline renders made with the game's own model and pose code. The build passes the full verifier and the dedicated-server check.
